preamble: The voiceless aspirated alveolo-palatal affricate [tɕʰ] is retracted to the aspirated retroflex affricate [ʈʂʰ]. In the history of Mandarin, the Middle Chinese 昌 (Chāng) initial of the palatal 章 series merged with the aspirated retroflex initials of the 知 and 莊 series, so Middle Chinese tɕʰ- surfaces as Mandarin ch- [ʈʂʰ]. It is the aspirated counterpart of the change of 章-initial tɕ- to Mandarin zh- [ʈʂ].
